description: This file defines function prototypes and a structure related to the handling of command-line options for diff and merge representations in a version control system. It appears to be part of a utility module focused on processing diff merge options.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configure diff merges based on string input.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppress parsing of certain merge options.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parse command-line options for diff merges.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppress diff merge representation for specified revisions.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Set default diff merge to use the first parent.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Set default diff merge to dense combined format.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Set dense combined if not already set.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initialize revision info for diff merges.
